stories.title: More than 600 children a day using Flintshire summer playschemes
stories.summary: More than 600 children a day are attending Flintshire’s free summer playschemes, with places still open at some of the 49 sites running through the holidays. stories.title: Walking and cycling route over Hawarden Bridge shut from Monday
stories.summary: The footway alongside Hawarden Bridge closes on Monday, and six days later the railway over it shuts for a fortnight. stories.title: Free tours of 1877 Hawarden building as part of Cadw Open Doors day
stories.summary: Hawarden Masonic Hall will open to the public for free tours on Saturday 12 September as part of Cadw Open Doors. The grade II listed building on Gladstone Way is one of several buildings in Hawarden taking part in the scheme, which is run by Cadw, the Welsh Government’s historic environment service. stories.title: Mold town centre roads to close for Tour of Britain Women stage start
stories.summary: Roads through Mold town centre will close to traffic between 11am and 2pm on Friday 21 August when the Lloyds Tour of Britain Women passes through, Flintshire County Council has confirmed.
